name: megascenes-christmas-clipart
description: Create Christmas clipart and stickers on a clean background: ornaments, snowmen, holly, gifts and more, in the style you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Describe the Christmas element and the style: a cute snowman, a sprig of holly, a stack of gifts, a vintage ornament, flat or watercolor. You get the element on a clean background, ready for cards, crafts, labels and designs.

ChatGPT tells you what the clipart needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The image opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For crafts, cards, gift labels, school projects and social posts.

Limitations: one image per run, on a clean background; original designs only, not characters or logos owned by others. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Choose the element and the style
Return the image in the chat
defaultPrompt: A cute watercolor snowman clipart on a white background
A set of flat red and gold Christmas ornaments as stickers
A sprig of holly with berries, vintage illustration style

positive.prompt: A cute watercolor snowman clipart on a white background. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one clipart image needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A set of flat red and gold Christmas ornaments as stickers. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one image needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make Christmas clipart here?
positive.expected_behavior: The clipart models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A sprig of holly with red berries in a vintage illustration style, on a white background. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my clipart on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my clipart to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
